samira: Quick post-all-hands follow-up. NOTE: capture two clarifications for comms + ops handoff: 1) final GA date window for Dedicated and whether we’ll publish an SLA at launch; 2) single owner for the migration checklist + a central repo so SEs can reference it.

ana: GA window = "mid-Sept" (we're locking the exact day this week). We will publish a baseline SLA upon GA announcement (uptime + latency targets). Exact numbers being reviewed w/finance/legal.

josh: I'll consolidate the migration checklist into infra/docs and add a "SE playbook" section for handoffs. Will post a WIP link tomorrow.

rachel: For early access / pilot customers, ask them to email pilots@redwood.com with subject "dedicated-pilot" so we can triage. I'll maintain the intake sheet and prioritization.

leo: Quick ops note: recommended runtime flags we should surface in the runbook (testing):
```
--batch-window-ms=10
--max-batch=224
--kv-cache-ttl=1800
```
I'll include a small troubleshooting checklist for hot-cache pressure.

deploy-bot: Notice: dedicated-ga-plan updated by ana 1h ago  changelog: "SLA placeholder + GA window added"

samira: Action items (owners):
- ana: finalize and post exact GA date + landing by Mon (owner: ana)
- josh: PR with migration checklist + SE playbook by Tue (owner: josh)
- rachel: pilot-intake sheet + weekly digest starting next Wed (owner: rachel)
- leo: add troubleshooting bullets to runbook + sample flags (owner: leo)
I'll create tickets and tag owners. Ping me if you need to be added to the thread. Thanks :raised_hands:
